body.message:
Good morning,

We would like to inform you that the rate for a 1-month stay (30 nights) is AED 4,500. Please also note that a refundable security/damage deposit of AED 1,500 is required.

The refundable damage deposit will be reimbursed within 7 to 14 working days after check-out, subject to a final inspection of the property. The deposit will be refunded in full via credit card or bank transfer, provided there are no damages or outstanding charges.
